result.analyst_notes: Promotional, awards-heavy page written in first-person plural with direct address to 'you'. Most content is third-party recognition and scale metrics rather than stated values. Customers are addressed first; community and financial outcomes appear briefly. Commitments are absolute and brief, with no elaboration on workforce, environment or governance.
